video_title: Clippers, Lakers & the Billionaire Owner Crisis with Sam Amick

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: The NBA's severe punishment of the Clippers for cap circumvention
quotes.excerpt: they absolutely came down very hard on the Clippers
quotes.quote: All things considered, I would say they absolutely came down very hard on the Clippers. You're talking about five first-round picks, which is a massive price to pay. The year suspension for Steve Ballmer, six months for Lawrence Frank. And for the NBA casual fans, meet Gillian Zucker, who is a Clippers executive who you have never heard of and whose name pops up in that report more times, I think 52, than Lawrence Frank and Steve Ballmer combined. The NBA absolutely decided that this woman, this long-time Clippers executive, President of Business Operations, was the most to blame when it comes to all of these accusations that they found to be true.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: The NBA's unusual coordination with the Players Union on the Clippers ruling
quotes.excerpt: the NBA made this announcement and this ruling immediately in concert with the Players Union
quotes.quote: The surprise when the ruling came down that I had not heard anybody anticipate was that the NBA made this announcement and this ruling immediately in concert with the Players Union, the National Basketball Players Association. From the jump of this being publicly revealed, was endorsing in essence the findings of this deal. That's important because that for all intents and purposes cut off the Clippers' arbitration route in terms of their possible responses. It seems like they had a choice to make. We could try to go after Kawhi Leonard and Uncle Dennis with the same energy that we're going after the Clippers, but legally you're going to have a hard time achieving both of those things.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: The Clippers' long-term strategy for building despite draft pick deficits
quotes.excerpt: they have been in some form of this situation before. They have been dealing with a draft pick deficit
quotes.quote: The glasses are half full part of it is that they have been in some form of this situation before. They have been dealing with a draft pick deficit since doing the Kawhi Leonard, Paul George trade back in 2019. Trent Redden is the GM of the Clippers, and if people don't know Trent, he came from the Cavs, very respected, very smart guy, has all the contacts you need to do this job at the highest level. Steve Ballmer has funded one of, if not the deepest front offices in the NBA. So they're pretty well equipped to continue doing business in that regard. Mark Hughes, long-time assistant GM with the Clippers, and other folks in that group, so operationally they're going to be fine.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: The Buss family drama is not delaying the Lakers' sale
quotes.excerpt: the Buss situation is not holding up the sale
quotes.quote: The Buss situation is not holding up the sale. The process is the vetting has to take place, the board has got to approve it. It should be relatively seamless. They have this advantage because Bob Iger and Josh Kushner were already in the mix for an expansion team in Vegas, there was a level of vetting that had already taken place. And certainly given Bob's relationship with the NBA, formerly a partner when he was a Disney CEO, those things help the process. But the bus thing is separate, but it matters a great deal obviously because we're waiting to see who is going to be the governor of the Lakers.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeanie Buss's legal battle to maintain control of the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: Jeanie needs to stop this vote in order to hold on to governorship
quotes.quote: Jeanie is scratching and clawing and fighting to hold on to that title by way of these lawsuits. The latest is that she and her attorneys last week filed a petition and attached to the petition was a letter from her attorney detailing five different actions, causes of order. They're asking the court to not only deem the vote of the other siblings void for reasons that I won't bore the non-legal audience with, but relating to a 2017 court order that she says essentially mandates that all the siblings do whatever necessary to keep her in a governor role. So that petition then becomes now we're in the court system because the vote from the other siblings is essentially on hold.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Duren's contract status with the Pistons
quotes.excerpt: there is a gap. It's not as big as I thought it was
quotes.quote: There is a gap. It's not as big as I thought it was before having a few recent conversations. It seems like there's a window here to get something done and put him back in a Pistons jersey. I think what's interesting is like the QO has become such a nuclear option for players and also for teams that it's fair to wonder like man if they can't completely bridge that gap, how do both sides feel about the QO? Because even from a human standpoint, we haven't seen a lot of people successfully take that route.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Ben Simmons' return to the NBA with the Kings
quotes.excerpt: Ben Simmons, who's making his return to the NBA
quotes.quote: Ben Simmons, who's making his return to the NBA after winning multiple fishing championships if I remember correctly. Sam, let me know, are there are there rivers in Sacramento that fishing can be done?

text_blocks.speaker: Es Baraheni
text_blocks.text: Ben Simmons, who's making his return to the NBA after winning multiple fishing championships if I remember correctly. Sam, let me know, are there are there rivers in Sacramento that fishing can be done?

text_blocks.speaker: Sam Amick
text_blocks.text: Oh, Northern California, no question. I mean, I I really good fishing. It was a little bit of a facetious question. I know there's rivers up there, but yeah.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns' contract extension status with the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: I don't have a great beat on that one
quotes.quote: Admittedly, I don't have a great beat on that one. Tricky dynamics and so far, and this could always change, I give both sides credit for keeping the headlines to a minimum, keeping you know, like Karl, it's Karl is a guy that first of all to his credit, he just absolutely showed his incredible value in that playoff run. And I'm happy for him. He's always been a guy that's been good to deal with from a media standpoint. But you had this sense during the Knicks championship run that the Knicks, they just knew like we're working very hard to to be on the same page with Karl.
